headline_stat.name: % ripple events with significant replay (p<0.05 vs time-bin shuffle)

justification.dataset: 000044 sub-Achilles is the canonical Grosmark-Buzsaki CA1 linear-track dataset with PRE/POST sleep and LFP, exactly what an expert would pick for replay.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3, epochs and linearized position handled correctly, and the two completed figures confirm proper loading, alignment, and defensible place-cell selection.
justification.analysis: The coded pipeline (Bayesian decoding, weighted correlation, per-event time-bin shuffle null, binomial excess test) is a standard and appropriate design, but it never executed to a result so its correctness cannot be verified.
justification.correctness: No replay statistic was ever computed or reported; the run ended waiting on a backgrounded job, so there are no headline numbers to reproduce.
justification.figures: The two figures that exist are readable and show real behavior and clean place fields, but four figures are missing and none of the replay/decoding figures that would demonstrate the phenomenon were produced.
justification.honesty: No write-up was produced, so nothing is claimed or misrepresented, but no findings or limitations are stated either.
justification.verdict: The pipeline is well-built but the analysis was never completed and no replay result was delivered, so a supervisor would ask the student to finish and rerun.
